jas: odd one from kumo-v2 q4 bring-up: when input mixes Mongolian script (vertical) with Chinese punctuation, closing punctuation (like ) and 。) gets rotated/duplicated after quant. repro on canary.

jas: repro (canary kumo-v2.q4):
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood-inference/canary/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACT' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"kumo-v2.q4","input":"\u1820\u1821\u1822 (\u4eca\u5929\u7684\u65b0\u95fb) \u3002"}'
```

jas: expected: ᠠᠡᠢ (今天的新闻) 。
jas: observed: ᠠᠡᠢ ((今天的新闻)) 。 <-- extra paren around CJK phrase and punctuation moved.

min: can you paste tokenizer tokens + script classes? want to confirm if parentheses are separate ON tokens or part of adjacent runs.

jas: token dump from canary q4 run:
```
tokens: ["\u1820\u1821\u1822"," ","(","\u4eca\u5929\u7684\u65b0\u95fb", ")"," ","\u3002"]
script_flags: [Mongolian,WS,ON,CJK,ON,WS,CJK_PUNCT]
```

oscar: interesting. q4 kernel changed small-token packing alignment for non-letter ON tokens. that can affect kvcache index reconstruction when scripts with vertical/rotation handling are present. int8/fp16 clean?

jas: yes int8 and fp16 are fine. this is q4-only.

l10n-bot: created locale set "mn-zh-punct-vertical" (420 examples) and ran initial eval: kumo-v2.fp16 BLEU 6.3; kumo-v2.q4 BLEU 3.4; kumo-v2.int8 BLEU 6.2. fails saved to /datasets/locale-onboard/mn-zh-punct-vertical/fails-3111111111.json

ci-bot: starting bisect across q4 kernel commits. ETA ~30m.

oscar: bisect points to the short-token pack offset change. experiment: disable packing for ON tokens adjacent to Mongolian/CJK and run canary A/B.

ci-bot: canary q4-hotfix deployed (packing-disabled-for-on-near-mn-cjk). Locale regression results: kumo-v2.q4-hotfix BLEU 6.0 (fp16 6.3). sample set: no paren duplication observed.

min: please add unit tests for Mongolian+CJK punctuation edge cases and monitor canary for 48h. also add a CI guard for mn-zh-punct-vertical with BLEU delta alert >1.0 for quant profiles.

oscar: PR #4993 opened with hotfix and tests. assigning @min and @jas. leaving canary monitor live.

jas: thanks team. archived failing examples to /tmp/kumo-q4-mn-zh-fails.json and will follow up if anything resurfaces.
